name: Medcaptain Medical Technology Co. Ltd. Class H
summary: Medcaptain Medical Technology Co., Ltd., incorporated in 2011 and based in Shenzhen, manufactures integrated perioperative medical devices sold through distributors across China, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Africa and the Americas. Its lines include life support products such as infusion systems and anesthesia machines, minimally invasive endoscopic products for digestive and urological care, and in vitro diagnostics. It was formerly Shenzhen Yusheng Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
